newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian preferred shares lead market gains.
newsitem.headline: Russian preferred shares lead market gains.

text.p: Preferred shares made up half of the list of the day's best-performing stocks on the Russian Trading System at 1450 GMT on Tuesday afternoon.
Oil company Surgutneftegaz prefs rose to $0.546 from $0.500 at Monday's close on 6,570,000 shares turnover.
Prefs of oil company Purneftegaz rose to $2.90 from $2.71 with 130,000 shares traded and utility Lenenergo prefs rose to $0.590 from $0.550 on 278,512 shares turnover.
Telecom MGTS (Moscow City Telephone) prefs rose to $0.80 from $0.77 on a volume of 970,150 shares.
Oil company Tomskneft prefs rose to $5.100 from $4.604 on 50,000 shares turnover.
Many traders say they expect discounts of preferred shares to ordinary shares to continue narrowing.
